notes: This is an English correction list referring to pages 335–354. Its fifteen page-reference blocks concern contractions, spelling, possessive its, prepositional wording and inadequacies.
At p.338 l-8 the writer puts a question mark before “and even” and follows it with “perhaps.” At p341 l.2 the proposal “and alongside got me back” is qualified by “is perhaps better.”
At p350 l-10 the proposed wording is “independent of”; the parenthesis says “from” can also be used but is less usual. The parenthesis continues on the next physical line.
The p344 entry has five line references across two physical lines. Its last first-line proposal, “commuting with”, is smaller and extends beyond the right rule.

The lower half is otherwise blank apart from continuing rules/traces, the small cancelled bottom-right note and the archive annotation 27. There is no written heading, title, date, stated page count or manuscript page number.
The quoted phrases about commuting are wording corrections; there is no displayed mathematical formula or mathematical assertion to test on this sheet.

brief_feedback: The required sequence was followed: whole once, each supplied full-resolution half once, then thirteen frozen unresolved loci and one enhanced crop per locus. No crop was repeated. The drawn parenthesis preserves an attached mark whose function remains uncertain. An anchored page field was necessary to retain the long rules crossing text and the bottom-right note rather than relocating those objects into disconnected panels. All text blocks, nested underline/deletion states and meaningful visible geometry have inventory entries; no mathematical check is claimed from reading the quoted wording.
